title: 第20章 元灵丹第21章 不能输
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
元灵丹乃是下品玄级丹，其稀有程度和宏伟程度根本无法与筑基丹相比。而且，它的药材比筑基丹还要难找，更何况炼制难度更是远超其他丹药。
筑基丹的炼制难度与上品灵级丹相差无几，主要是因为所需的药材较同类丹品更为稀有珍贵，所以才被纳入下品玄级丹中。但元灵丹的材料不仅更加稀有，炼制难度也极高。
大量的养魂草和神灵花都是沉翔培育出来的，虽然都是幼苗，但他却有金龙唾液。让这些花花草草更快成熟一点也不难。
包间内，沉翔按照苏媚瑶的吩咐，处理着那些草药。养魂草只需要靠近根部的一小部分。而神灵花只需要特定的花瓣和根即可。以上所有这些都需要非常仔细地处理。如果多了一点点，就会导致灵气混乱，导致炼制失败。
神灵花和养魂草是主要材料。除此之外，还有许多其他的辅助药草，足足有三十多种。这些药材都是比较常见的药材，比如人参、灵草、妖丹等等。不过，这些药草的年龄要求相当高，最低也要三千岁。所以说，这些辅助药材也是相当难找的。不过，这对于沉翔来说，并不是什么难事。无论是最近的药园入侵，还是玄武秘境，他都早已得到了所需的辅助药材。
将辅料和主料加工整理统一后，沉翔将每一套都收进了一个单独的玉盒中。足足完成了数十套，他才取出炎炎龙炉，开始炼化。
沉翔已经从苏媚瑶那里学到了炼制元灵丹的全部过程。但元灵丹的本质与他之前炼制的其他丹相比并不相同，所以他需要亲身体验，注重细节。
当这些草药被放入炎炎龙炉之中时，沉翔释放出火焰，瞬间将这些草药烧毁。一开始的时候，火焰太过强烈，导致这些药材突然燃烧起来，释放出一阵强横的灵气。它们在炉内相互碰撞，让炎龙炉剧烈的晃动起来。
沉翔立即用神念压制住这些强横的灵气，然后逐渐释放出来。那些灵气离开炎炎龙炉之后，便散开，消失在天地之间。
“唉，这一套就废了！”
沉翔叹了口气。一开始就立刻遭遇失败，对他来说是一个意外的打击，这是他已经很久没有经历过的事情了。
“你既然拥有了天阳火灵，那么你的火焰就非常的强烈。而且，这个过程和之前的很不一样，这些草药很容易被焚毁。事实上，我已经警告过你了。”
苏媚瑶毫无顾忌的斥责他。
沉翔点了点头，再次开始炼化。
第二次，他一点一点慢慢地烘烤那些药草，让灵气慢慢释放出来。与此同时，他用神念将那些释放出来的各种草药灵气融合在一起。
“开始了！”
陈翔皱起眉头。这一刻，他的神识开始流失，因为养魂草和神灵花都产生了神识，这些神识无主，本能的吸收着其他神识的力量。此刻，他们正在吸收沉翔的神念。
药草吸收神念太多，就会导致炼丹失败，太少也会有同样的结果。对于整个过程来说，非常精确的控制是绝对必要的。
陈翔再次失败。他担心自己的神识被吸收太多，所以他将那些草药灵气和草药粉末融合的太快，没有提前尝试凝丹。结果灵气吸收的神念太少，导致力量不够。所以，丹在凝固的过程中，是非常松散的，然后才慢慢散开。
炼丹正是如此，只有在一次又一次的失败之后，炼丹师才能成功抓住最关键的一点。

就连炼制筑基丹的时候，沉翔也失败过很多次。更不用说比筑基丹还要难炼数倍的元灵丹了！
转眼间，十天过去了。沉翔已经失败了七十次了！
“还不够，才七十次而已！继续！”
苏媚瑶满意地点点头。如果沉翔尝试了四十五十次就成功了，那就太不正常了。苏媚瑶虽然知道沉翔在炼丹方面有着极其逆天的天赋，但也应该有一个限度。现在终于看到沉翔失败了这么多次，不知道为什么，她的心情却很好。
见苏媚瑶这么高兴，沉翔开心地笑道：“媚瑶姐，我们打赌，我不会失败一百次，就能成功炼制这元灵丹。”
苏媚瑶和白幽幽都在擂台之内。虽然没有其他人在场，但这里依然是太武宗的地盘。这里有不少涅盘境武者，担心被发现，所以不敢出来。
想了想，苏媚瑶答应道：“好吧！如果你输了，你就得在太武宗的广场上大声喊三声‘我是白痴’，如果我输了……”
沉翔笑道：“如果你输了，你就亲我的嘴唇吧！怎么样？”
苏媚瑶陷入了沉思。她想了想，知道具体需要吸收多少神识，是一个巨大的障碍。即使失败了七十次，沉翔还是没能控制住适量。更何况，到了后期凝丹的时候，神识化成的大量无主灵力的压制，极难与药粉融合。这个关卡还需要多次失败才能成功，至少对她来说是这样。
如果苏媚瑶输了，她就得亲吻沉翔的唇。这个股份比陈翔的股份要大一些。毕竟，如果她赢了，沉翔只需要喊三遍‘我是白痴’就可以了。
苏媚瑶纯粹是无聊，所以才想找点刺激，找点乐子。
“嗯，这样吧，你要是输了，就去亲祝融的脸颊，而且，还要当着云小刀和眯龙的面！”
苏媚瑶娇笑道。想到这一幕，她就忍不住笑了。
光是想到这一点，沉翔就感到恶心。现在他已经没有信心将失败控制在一百次以下了。如果他输了，那就太惨了。
不过，如果沉翔赢了，他就可以亲吻苏媚瑶的唇了。这种诱惑实在是太大了，这就是赌博。输了极其痛苦，赢了则无比喜悦！
沉翔也沉思了一会儿，点了点头，“好吧，不过你吻我的时间长一点，不能是浅浅的吻一下。”
“没问题！”
苏媚瑶娇笑道：“你确定能赢？”
沉翔笑道：“没有，不过想吻你的诱惑太大了，这么美的人，就算输得很惨我也得试试！媚瑶姐，你放心，我很有经验的。”接吻，到时候我就教你怎么做，你虽然活了很久，但我敢肯定，你绝对没有经验！”
苏媚瑶并不讨厌沉翔，相反，她还挺喜欢他的。沉翔长得够帅，天赋也很出色，如果将来成为一名强大的武者，确实是一个不错的搭档。再说了，她裸露的玉体已经被沉翔看到了，现在看来，吻他也没什么意义。不过，不知道为什么，她却有些期待，如果自己输了，会发生什么。活了这么久，她确实没有吻过男人。

“悠悠姐，你也来凑热闹如何？”
想到要吻白幽幽，沉翔顿时更加兴奋了。与苏媚瑶不同，白幽幽这个冰山美人，对她的征服欲更加强烈。
content_en:
The Yuanling Pill is a low-grade Xuan-level pill, and its rarity and magnificence cannot be compared with the Foundation-Building Pill. Moreover, its medicinal materials are harder to find than the Foundation Establishment Pill, not to mention that the difficulty of refining it is far higher than other pills.
The difficulty of refining the foundation-building pill is almost the same as that of the high-grade spirit-level pills. This is mainly because the medicinal materials required are rarer and more precious than similar pills, so they are included in the lower-grade mysterious pills. But the materials for the Yuanling Pill are not only rarer, but also extremely difficult to refine.
A large number of soul-nurturing grasses and divine flowers were cultivated by Chen Xiang. Although they were all seedlings, he had golden dragon saliva. It's not hard at all to get these flowers to mature faster.
In the private room, Chen Xiang processed the herbs according to Su Meiyao's instructions. Soul-nourishing grass only requires a small portion near the roots. The spirit flower only needs specific petals and roots. All of the above need to be handled very carefully. If it is a little too much, it will cause confusion in the spiritual energy and result in refining failure.
Spirit flower and soul-nourishing grass are the main materials. In addition, there are many other auxiliary herbs, more than thirty kinds in total. These medicinal materials are relatively common medicinal materials, such as ginseng, spiritual grass, demon pill, etc. However, the age requirements for these herbs are quite high, with a minimum age of three thousand years. Therefore, these auxiliary medicinal materials are also quite difficult to find. However, this is not a difficult problem for Chen Xiang. Whether it was the recent invasion of the medicine garden or the Xuanwu secret realm, he had already obtained the auxiliary medicinal materials he needed.
After processing and unifying the auxiliary materials and main materials, Chen Xiang put each set into a separate jade box. After completing dozens of sets, he took out the Flame Dragon Furnace and started refining.
Chen Xiang has already learned the entire process of refining the Yuanling Pill from Su Meiyao. But the essence of the Yuanling Pill is different from other pills he has refined before, so he needs to experience it personally and pay attention to details.
When these herbs were put into the Flame Dragon Furnace, Chen Xiang released flames and burned the herbs instantly. At the beginning, the flames were too strong, causing the medicinal materials to suddenly burn and release a burst of powerful spiritual energy. They collided with each other in the furnace, causing the Yanlong furnace to shake violently.
Chen Xiang immediately used his spiritual thoughts to suppress these powerful spiritual energies, and then gradually released them. After the spiritual energy left the Yanyan Dragon Furnace, it dispersed and disappeared between heaven and earth.
"Oh, this is useless!"
Chen Xiang sighed. The immediate failure at the beginning was an unexpected blow to him, something he had not experienced in a long time.
"Since you have the Tianyang Fire Spirit, your flames are very strong. Moreover, this process is very different from the previous ones. These herbs are easily burned. In fact, I have already warned you."
Su Meiyao scolded him without any scruples.
Chen Xiang nodded and started refining again.
The second time, he slowly roasted the herbs bit by bit, allowing the spiritual energy to slowly be released. At the same time, he used his spiritual thoughts to fuse the released auras of various herbs together.
"It's begun!"
Chen Xiang frowned. At this moment, his spiritual consciousness began to drain away, because both the soul-nurturing grass and the spirit flower produced spiritual consciousness. These spiritual consciousnesses had no owner and instinctively absorbed the power of other spiritual consciousnesses. At this moment, they were absorbing Chen Xiang's spiritual thoughts.
If the medicinal herbs absorb too much spiritual energy, the alchemy will fail, and too little will have the same result. Very precise control is absolutely necessary for the entire process.
Chen Xiang failed again. He was worried that too much of his spiritual consciousness would be absorbed, so he fused the herbal spiritual energy and herbal powder too quickly without trying to condense the elixir in advance. As a result, the spiritual energy absorbed by the spiritual energy was too little, resulting in insufficient power. Therefore, the Dan is very loose during the solidification process, and then slowly spreads out.
This is exactly what alchemy is. Only after failing again and again can the alchemist successfully grasp the ultimate goal.A crucial point.
Even when refining the Foundation Building Pill, Chen Xiang failed many times. Not to mention the Yuanling Pill, which is several times more difficult to refine than the Foundation Establishment Pill!
In the blink of an eye, ten days passed. Chen Xiang has failed seventy times!
"It's not enough, it's only seventy times! Keep going!"
Su Meiyao nodded with satisfaction. If Chen Xiang succeeded after trying forty or fifty times, it would be too abnormal. Although Su Meiyao knew that Chen Xiang was extremely talented in alchemy, there should be a limit. Now that she finally saw Chen Xiang fail so many times, she felt very good for some reason.
Seeing that Su Meiyao was so happy, Chen Xiang smiled happily and said, "Sister Meiyao, let's bet that I won't fail a hundred times before I can successfully refine this Yuanling Pill."
Su Meiyao and Bai Youyou are both in the ring. Although no one else is present, this is still the territory of Taiwuzong. There are many Nirvana realm warriors here who are worried about being discovered, so they dare not come out.
After thinking about it, Su Meiyao agreed: "Okay! If you lose, you have to shout 'I am an idiot' three times in the Taiwuzong Square. If I lose..."
Chen Xiang smiled and said: "If you lose, just kiss my lips! How about it?"
Su Meiyao fell into deep thought. She thought about it and realized how much spiritual consciousness needed to be absorbed was a huge obstacle. Even after failing seventy times, Chen Xiang still failed to control the right amount. What's more, when it comes to condensing the elixir in the later stages, the suppression of a large amount of ownerless spiritual power formed by divine consciousness will be extremely difficult to integrate with the medicinal powder. This level also requires multiple failures before success, at least for her.
If Su Meiyao loses, she will have to kiss Chen Xiang's lips. This shareholding is larger than Chen Xiang's shareholding. After all, if she wins, Chen Xiang only needs to shout 'I am an idiot' three times.
Su Meiyao was simply bored, so she wanted to find some excitement and fun.
"Well, let's do this. If you lose, you go and kiss Zhu Rong on the cheek, and you have to do it in front of Yun Xiaodao and Milong!"
Su Meiyao smiled sweetly. Thinking of this scene, she couldn't help laughing.
Just thinking of this made Chen Xiang feel sick. Now he no longer has the confidence to limit his failures to less than a hundred times. It would be too bad if he loses.
However, if Chen Xiang wins, he can kiss Su Meiyao's lips. The temptation is too great, this is gambling. Losing is extremely painful, winning is extremely joyful!
Chen Xiang also pondered for a while and nodded, "Okay, but you kiss me for a longer time, not just a shallow kiss."
"No problem!"
Su Meiyao smiled sweetly and said, "Are you sure you can win?"
Chen Xiang smiled and said: "No, but the temptation to kiss you is too great. For such a beautiful person, I have to try even if I lose miserably! Sister Meiyao, don't worry, I am very experienced." Kissing, I will teach you how to do it when the time comes. Although you have lived for a long time, I am sure that you have absolutely no experience! "
Su Meiyao didn't hate Chen Xiang, on the contrary, she quite liked him. Chen Xiang is handsome enough and has outstanding talents. If he becomes a powerful warrior in the future, he will indeed be a good partner. Besides, her naked body has been seen by Chen Xiang, and now it seems that there is no point in kissing him. However, for some reason, she was looking forward to what would happen if she lost. In all her life, she had never kissed a man.
"Sister Youyou, how about you come and join in the fun? "
Chen Xiang suddenly became even more excited when he thought of kissing Bai Youyou. Unlike Su Meiyao, Bai Youyou, this iceberg beauty, has an even stronger desire to conquer her.
